auth.howToCopy: No token needed: search and job pages are public and were read as a guest (no cookies).

clauses: bạn không được sao chép, sửa đổi, điều chỉnh, chuẩn bị các sản phẩm phái sinh dựa trên
TopCV có thể chấm dứt quyền sử dụng một hoặc tất cả các dịch vụ của bạn mà không cần thông báo trước
TopCV có quyền trục xuất Người Dùng và ngăn chặn quyền truy cập sau đó của họ tới trang web TopCV.vn

accountRisk: Low. Reads are guest page GETs, so Ba's TopCV account is not involved. The terms (dated 01/04/2025) have no clause on bots, crawlers or automated access; they forbid copying/derivative use of TopCV content and allow TopCV to end service or block access for violations. robots.txt (2026-10-19) allows job and search pages (it disallows only CV paths). Third-party scrapers report TopCV sometimes serves a Cloudflare challenge; a guest curl on 2026-10-19 was not challenged.
notes: No JSON API: these are server-rendered HTML pages; read the JSON-LD blocks (script[type='application/ld+json']). Search page: a JSON array whose element with @type ['SearchResultsPage','CollectionPage'] has mainEntity.itemListElement[].item {name, url} (name = job title, url = canonical job URL without query). City slugs: ho-chi-minh-kl2, ha-noi-kl1, da-nang-kl8 (see bots/research/skills/source-topcv/SKILL.md); the slug 'tai-ho-chi-minh' without -kl2 returned 0 jobs. Pagination ?page=N (the site appends ?u_sr_id=<tracking>&page=0 on redirect: drop u_sr_id). Search JSON-LD has no company/salary; take them from the detail page. Detail page: JSON-LD @type JobPosting with title, description (full JD as HTML: 'Mô tả công việc', requirements, benefits), identifier {name: company name, value: company id}, datePosted, validThrough, hiringOrganization, jobLocation (PostalAddress), baseSalary (value 'Thoả thuận' = negotiable, or numbers, VND/MONTH), experienceRequirements, skills. Job id = the number before .html. Pages are large (1.3-1.6 MB each): one search page + one detail page per job. Observed with guest curl (Chrome extension was not connected), not in Ba's logged-in Chrome; no XHR JSON endpoints observed.
